name: functions
description: Cloud Functions for Pulse Platform Actions Engine

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-pulse-local --only firestore "node --test lib/integration/*.test.js"
scripts.test:profiles: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-pulse-local --only firestore "node --test lib/integration/runner-profiles.cross-repo.js"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase serve --only functions
scripts.test:rules: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-pulse-tes333 --only firestore "node --test lib/rules/*.test.js"
